# NARION Smart Hookah Systems

> Designer & 5-axis CNC manufacturer of AISI 316L stainless steel hookahs (17 architectural models) and the coal-free NARION Smart HMD electric heat management system (közsüz ısıtma combustion, ±1°C PID thermal control, ~35 min fast-charge cartridge for 90+ min sessions, Cool-Touch™ active exterior cooling <42°C, NARION Connect™ tobacco-matched temperature curves, and 45° Bayonet lock). Istanbul, Turkey.
